entries.logic: Using CAT to allow the Agent to modify its own logic zones
entries.rationale: SS QLM allows an AI agent to safely 'evolve' code by restricting modifications to well-defined markers. 'cat' acts as the secure bridge for the AI to deposit new instructions without risking the structural integrity of the surrounding C++ or Shell infrastructure.

entries.example_pattern:
for mod in auth logs database; do
    cat > "src/modules/${mod}.sh" <<EOF
# Module: ${mod}
# Generated by SS QLM Agent
EOF
done
entries.rationale: Automating the creation of modular systems. SS QLM leverages 'cat' for its ability to iterate and produce multiple consistent artifacts from a single logic loop.
